facts.fact: 洞缝里的生物有半透明细肢与畸形人头、多排人牙——cave angler 用吃下去的受害者特征装点自己。
facts.anchor: Her light exposes a tangle of translucent limbs branching off into tiny hands, thin veins visible through the pale skin. The creature’s snakelike body tapers into a misshapen human head with stringy black hair and a gaping maw with multiple rows of human teeth.

facts.fact: 它继续用 Jade 的声音说「下面有宝藏」招揽两人。
facts.anchor: “Down here,” the cave angler says, still in Jade’s voice. “Much treasure. Come, come.”

facts.fact: 两人的刀与喷雾都来不及：细小的手从 Henry 眼眶穿入、把他的脸撕下来喂进口中。
facts.anchor: Henry’s right eye starts getting bigger and bigger, and with a wet pop, Henry’s eyeball shoots out of its socket as the angler’s tiny hand pushes through the eyehole. The hand feels across Henry’s face, then plunges through his left eye. His thrashing turns into involuntary twitching as the hands continue tearing him apart, tossing strips of his face into the angler’s mouth.

facts.fact: Petra 掷出油瓶、火在其发间炸开，怪物用上百个人声同时尖叫。
facts.anchor: I chuck it at the creature’s head. The oil splatters on the cave angler’s stringy black hair, flames erupting over its flesh. Its mouth stretches wide as it starts to shriek in a hundred different voices, agonized human screams overlapping in a gruesome cacophony.

facts.fact: Jade 的论证：已杀掉第三层最恶之一、没带客人回去就拿不到钱、黑记录会让活儿更难找，既然已下来就尽量搜宝。
facts.anchor: “We already killed one of the worst monsters in the Third”⁠—Jade gestures at the cave angler’s body like it’s her trophy⁠—“and you know what’s going to happen when we get topside and don’t have Henry with us? We’re not getting paid. Jobs are going to be harder to get with a black mark on our record. We’re already down here. I say we use this time to get as much treasure as we can.”

facts.fact: 醋味的黏液与融化的尸体指向 bonedrinker——那人是被假宝石诱到、被开膛后封进溶钙分泌物的。
facts.anchor: The fact that the slime smells like vinegar, paired with the way the man is melting inside⁠—this must be the work of a bonedrinker. Poor guy must’ve thought he found a jackpot when he saw a fat, sparkling gem sitting in the open, but was in for a nasty surprise when it turned out to be a bonedrinker’s tail and he got disemboweled. Now, he’s encased in the creature’s calcium-liquifying secretions.

facts.fact: 洗去绿泥，gem 是亮橙色，光强得像小太阳；Petra 承认「我们能留下它」时带着愧疚的松快。
facts.anchor: The green goo washes away, revealing a bright-orange glow gem, and I feel some guilty relief. We get to keep it. The gem’s orange glow is so powerful, it’s like a small sun illuminating the long tunnel.

facts.fact: Jade 在崖壁上踩滑，双脚抽空、双手乱抓。
facts.anchor: She flashes me a thumbs-up and reaches for another rock. Her shoe slips from the ledge she was standing on. Her eyes bulge as her feet fall out from under her, hands frantically grasping at nothing.

facts.fact: Petra 跳回骨堆洞底救 Jade，手掌被骨茬刺穿，一边包扎一边找她。
facts.anchor: I spring to my feet and leap down into the cave angler’s pit, landing hard on my hands and knees. A shard of bone pierces my palm. “Damn it!” I yank the bone from my skin and pull a bandage from my bag, wrapping the wound while I look around for Jade.

facts.fact: 两人约定要报暗号，用来确认自己追随的声线不是怪物。
facts.anchor: “Say the password!” I clutch my hands together, listening for her response.

facts.fact: 她撞断了自己的头灯，备用灯泡找不到——大部分装备（连火柴）都在 Jade 包里。
facts.anchor: I must’ve run into a stalactite in just the right spot. How could I have been so stupid? I fumble around in my backpack, searching for a spare bulb. But I can’t find anything⁠—Jade had most of the supplies. Even the matches.

facts.fact: 她在黑暗里摸到一处断崖边缘，伸手只抓到空。
facts.anchor: I move forward on all fours, feeling my way with my hands. My fingers meet the edge of the ground, and beyond that⁠—nothing. I reach down, trying to discern how far this drop-off goes. All I grasp is empty air.

facts.fact: 她的计划是折回 Henry 的尸体旁取灯，再前进找 Jade。
facts.anchor: Then I can get whatever supplies are left on Henry’s body, and once I have lights, I can push forward to find Jade.
